## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Issues

Use `Closes #N` for each issue whose full acceptance criteria this PR fulfills.
Use `Refs #N` for partial work. Explain remaining work for referenced issues.

## Validation

Record focused execution, required baseline results and material limitations.
Keep failures and ignored/manual tests explicit.

## Independent review

Record the dispatched review agent, significant fixes pushed, reviewed commit
and successful CI on the final head. Do not merge until the user authorizes it.
